Tests breakable locations in comma expressions.

Running test: testBreakLocations

function testFunction() {
  |C|foo(), |C|foo(), |C|foo();
  |_|return |C|bar(), |C|bar();|R|
}

function foo() {
  |_|return |C|baz(), |C|baz();|R|
}

function bar() {
  |_|return |C|foo(),
         1 |_|+ |C|foo(),
         2 |_|+ |C|foo();|R|
}

const baz = |_|() => |_|0|R|;

function testLoopConditions() {
  while (|C|baz(), |C|baz()) {}
  for (; |C|baz(), |C|baz();) {}
  while ((|C|baz(), |C|baz()), |C|baz()) {}
  while (|C|baz(), (|C|baz(), |C|baz())) {}
  while ((|C|baz(), |C|baz()), |C|baz(), |C|baz()) {}
  while ((|C|baz(), |C|baz(), |C|baz()), |C|baz()) {}
|R|}
|R|
